address.scope: address bound to an installation key
conditions: an announced address change ends the route
the relay can close quiet streams after about two minutes
browsers can show a warning page

cost.summary: The free tier costs nothing and needs no account; Pro is $6 a month or $60 a year and removes time limits and the warning page.

disclosure.text: Start a public HTTPS trial through the tunnl.gg relay. The relay terminates TLS and can read payloads. Quiet streams can close after two minutes.

protocols.sse/streamableHttp: true. Backed by validation.sse (timed incremental event delivery when required) and validation.publish (exact-origin approval only after all required probes) in the wrapped recipe definition, with admission.requiredFeatures probe-assertions and client-vantage-probe.
protocols.oauthDcr: oauthDcr: the stable user gives 'a URL tied to your SSH key that stays the same across reconnects' (https://tunnl.gg); Gozar preserves the configured authority. The wrapped recipe's addressStability 'random' conflicts with this page and is reported as an open question.
